Per workspace rule: after plan approval, create an epic + child beads before coding.

description: src/time_stepping/ ports ONLY RKF45 -- an EXPLICIT adaptive method that will step down to Lambda on a stiff problem and stall (eigenvalue spread ~1e6 thermal, ~1e9 fast) -- and NO test exercises the RKF45 path, so its stiff behaviour is unobserved. Rosenbrock12.C, Rosenbrock34.C, rodas23.C and rodas34.C are ALREADY VENDORED in src/time_stepping/openfoam_source_files/ and none is ported. Cheapest robustness win in the scoping document: the reference implementation is already on disk. Add a stiff-problem test at the same time.
title: teh-o-prke: port one Rosenbrock stiff integrator from the vendored OpenFOAM source
